# semrel

> semrel is an open-source, plugin-based semantic release automation tool written in Go.
> It is the **zero-dependency alternative to semantic-release** — no Node.js, no npm, no node_modules.
> semrel reads Conventional Commits, calculates the correct SemVer bump (major/minor/patch),
> generates a changelog, updates project files, creates a git tag, and publishes releases on
> GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Bitbucket, or plain Git — automatically and reproducibly.
> It is air-gap ready, supply-chain secure (Cosign + SBOM + SLSA), and works as a single static binary.

## Documentation

- [Introduction & Comparison with alternatives](https://semrel.io/getting-started/introduction/): What semrel is, why no Node.js, how it compares to semantic-release and goreleaser.
- [semrel vs semantic-release vs goreleaser](https://semrel.io/guide/comparison/): Full feature matrix, migration guide from semantic-release, decision guide.
- [Installation](https://semrel.io/getting-started/installation/): Installing via Go, Docker, Homebrew, or binary download.
- [Quick Start](https://semrel.io/getting-started/quick-start/): Run your first automated release in 5 minutes.
- [Configuration Reference](https://semrel.io/guide/configuration/): Full `.semrel.yaml` schema reference.
- [CLI Reference](https://semrel.io/guide/cli/): All `semrel` CLI commands and flags.
- [Monorepo Guide](https://semrel.io/guide/monorepo/): Versioning multiple modules in one repository.
- [Docker Usage](https://semrel.io/guide/docker/): Running semrel inside Docker or CI containers.
- [CI Outputs](https://semrel.io/guide/ci-outputs/): Reading semrel outputs in GitHub Actions / GitLab CI.

## Plugins

- [Plugin Overview](https://semrel.io/plugins/overview/): How the plugin system works, env vars, lifecycle.
- [Managing Plugins](https://semrel.io/plugins/managing/): Installing, locking, and restoring plugins.
- [Official Plugins](https://semrel.io/plugins/): The full catalog of officially maintained plugins.
- [Plugin Registry](https://semrel.io/plugins/registry/): Browsing and publishing plugins to registry.semrel.io.
- [Plugin SDK / Development](https://semrel.io/plugins/sdk/): Writing your own semrel plugin in any language.
- [Publishing a Plugin](https://semrel.io/plugins/publishing/): How to submit a plugin to the registry.
